notes: League Points unlock Relic tiers and determine trophy progression.
Blessings are unlocked through separate combat-focused Blessing Tasks in chosen regions.
progression.task_point_value_note: The July 23 Jagex reveal explicitly says tasks span Easy through Master and rewards run from 10 points for quick wins up to 400 for major achievements. The 30/80/200 intermediate values match Catalyst but remain provisional until an Equilibrium-specific source publishes them explicitly.

quest_behavior.summary: Each unlocked region auto-completes a large number of quests so core regional content becomes immediately accessible.
examples: Tirannwn is intended to provide immediate access to Prifddinas.
Desert is intended to provide near-immediate access to Menaphos.

relics.design_goal: fewer obvious best-in-slot picks and stronger playstyle differentiation

tier_1.name: Survivalist
effects: Doubles resources from Mining, Fishing, Woodcutting, and Archaeology excavation hotspots.
Provides powerful gathering tools for Mining, Woodcutting, and Fishing.
Provides Survivalist's Bag storing up to 150 of three different log, ore, or fish types.

tier_1.name: Endless Harvest
effects: Archaeology, Farming, Fishing, Mining, and Woodcutting resources can be sent directly to bank or metal bank.
Fishing, Mining, and Woodcutting have a 10% chance to upgrade gathered resources to the next tier.
Trees are rarely felled and gathering automatically resumes when they regrow.
Fishing spots can be followed automatically when they move.
Archaeology behaves as if a Time Sprite is always active.

tier_1.name: Golden Touch
effects: Provides Goldenhawk Boots, tier-60 hybrid boots that periodically award Agility XP while moving, skilling, or using ultimate abilities.
Agility and Thieving can award Goldenhawk Feathers convertible to Prayer XP or coins.
Doubles Agility course XP and prevents course or shortcut failures.
Awards coins per completed Agility lap based on Agility level.
Thieving checks always succeed, loot is tripled and automatically noted.
Stalls never deplete, safes have no cooldown, and repeat Thieving actions continue automatically.
Coins from Thieving are multiplied by 100.
Chests and safes can additionally award herbs and potion ingredients sent to bank.

tiers_2_to_7.reveal_schedule: Daily reveals begin 2026-07-28 and continue through launch.

god_tier_resolution.chaos: two or more Chaos choices in the preceding block
god_tier_resolution.order: two or more Order choices in the preceding block
god_tier_resolution.balance: two or more Balance choices, or one choice from each path, in the preceding block

resets.notes: One reset is available from tier 1; two more unlock later.

passive_bonus_examples: removal of equipment degradation and other traditional PvM costs
